data.content:
Wikivoyage guide for Kandy (all topics):
[Introduction] Kandy is in the centre of Sri Lanka 125 km away from Colombo and is generally recognised as the island nation's cultural capital. It is on the UNESCO World Heritage List.
[Understand] This is the last kingdom of the country. Since it was conquered by the British around 1815 you can still see the living traditions. Kandyans are usually proud of their heritage. Since the western elements has played a comparatively little role in the city most Kandyans uphold Buddhist values. Since it is in the cultural triangle the authorities try to retain this values as much as possible. ...
[Get in] By train: From Colombo - Intercity express trains are hassle-free and scenic, 2½-3 hours, 10 trains per day. There is a great observation saloon (first class) on one of these trains, but this often books out. Other trains are usually crowded and depart late. Tickets from Colombo are Rs 7,000 first class, Rs 500 in second class, Rs 240 in third class (2023). ...
[Get around] The local "Three-Wheelers" ('Tuk-Tuk) are an amazingly cheap (if you know how to haggle! If you can get them for Rs 60-70 per Km you are doing well) and exciting way of seeing the city, and they run virtually all night long. However, beware of the Tuk-Tuk mafia at the Kandy railway station – they are likely to rip you off (and they threaten Uber or PickMe drivers when they collect passengers near their stand). ...
[See] 1 Temple of the Tooth (Sri Dalada Maligawa), ☏ +94 812234226, fax: +94 8112236201, maligawa@sltnet.lk. Dawn to dusk. It houses a tooth relic of the Lord Buddha, and is consequently considered one of Sri Lanka's most holy shrines. Although you should expect that you will not be able to view the actual tooth itself, the casket within which it is said to be is displayed twice a day. ...
[Do] Kandyan dancing — traditional form of dancing, which can be seen at multiple venues including that the "Kandy Cultural Centre" near the Kandy lake. As of 2024, expect prices to range from 2000 to 3500 per ticket for about 1 hour performances, not including intermission time. 1 Buddhist Publication Society, 54 Sangharaja Mawatha (near the lake), ☏ +94 81 2 237283. Mon-Sat 9AM–4:30PM. ...
[Sleep] There are many hostels, budget, midrange and splurge hotels in Kandy, where you can stay the night and rest easily. Budget: There are lots of cheapish guest houses to the south and east of the lake, all only a short walk from the town centre, and generally clean and friendly. Burmese Rest. The cheapest option in the city. The Buddhist monks are friendly and the building is a quiet retreat from Kandy's noisy streets. ...
[Cope] 1 Kandy Tourist Police. (updated Nov 2016) Hospitals: Major hospitals and health care centres: General Hospital Kandy, ☏ +94 81 2222261. Teaching Hospital - Peradeniya, ☏ +94 81 2388001. Sirimavo Bandaranaike Specialised Children's Hospital - Peradeniya. Suwasewana Hospital, 532, Peradeniya Rd, ☏ +94 81 2222404, fax: +94 81 4476763. ...
Sections ending in ... were shortened; full article: https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Kandy
Source: Wikivoyage, community-written (CC BY-SA 4.0); prices, timetables and transport details may be out of date.

# 2-day trip to Kandy

A 2-day cultural and temple exploration in Kandy for 1 traveler starting from Colombo. The itinerary includes visiting the Temple of the Tooth, watching traditional Kandyan dancing, exploring scenic viewpoints, and seeing historic sites.

**Starting point:** Colombo

## Day 1: Arrival & Sacred Relic Visit
*Weather:* 2026-11-23: moderate rain showers; min 21.8 °C, max 30.2 °C; chance of precipitation 100%; rainfall 8.2 mm; max wind 12.1 km/h (Open-Meteo)
*Travel:* Colombo to Kandy: 115 km, about 2 h 12 min by car without traffic (OSRM)
- **Afternoon: Temple of the Tooth (Sri Dalada Maligawa)** (about 2 h) - Visit Sri Lanka's sacred temple housing the tooth relic of the Lord Buddha in central Kandy. _(Wikivoyage)_
- **Evening: Kandy Cultural Centre** (about 1.5 h) - Experience a traditional 1-hour Kandyan dancing performance near Kandy Lake. _(Wikivoyage)_

## Day 2: Viewpoints & Local Cultural Sights
*Weather:* 2026-11-24: dense drizzle; min 21.0 °C, max 29.2 °C; chance of precipitation 100%; rainfall 3.7 mm; max wind 9.5 km/h (Open-Meteo)
- **Morning: Viewpoint of Asgiri Maha Vihara Pirivena** (about 1 h; 0.6 km straight-line) - Take in scenic views of Kandy town and monastic pirivena from this vantage point. _(OpenStreetMap)_
- **Morning: Arthur’s Seat** (about 1 h; 0.7 km straight-line) - Enjoy panoramic vistas overlooking Kandy Lake and the surrounding hills. _(OpenStreetMap)_
- **Afternoon: Giragama Walawwa** (about 1 h; 0.5 km straight-line) - Explore the historic ancestral walawwa architectural site near the city center. _(OpenStreetMap)_
- **Afternoon: The Kandy Clock Tower** (about 0.5 h; 0.3 km straight-line) _(OpenStreetMap)_

## Entrance fees (official sources)
- Sri Dalada Maligawa: no official price found. Requires confirmation before you go.

## Other costs (estimates from Wikivoyage, may be out of date)
- **Second Class Train Ticket (Colombo to Kandy)**
  - Price: LKR 500 (per person) x 2
  - Quantity: 2 trips (round trip Colombo-Kandy) for 1 person
  - Per person: LKR 1,000
  - For the group: LKR 1,000

## Where to stay (mid-range places)
- **Hill Top Hotel (Mid-range)**
  - Price: US$53-60(2014) (listed 2014, may have changed)
  - Two star hotel. 73 standard rooms. The onsite restaurant serves a variety of local and international dishes.
  - Website: https://www.aitkenspencehotels.com/factsheets/hotelhilltop/factsheets.pdf
- **Golden View Rest (Mid-range)**
  - Price: Room from Rs 1,500 (date of listing unknown)
  - View on the lake and a part of the city. Hot water and very clean rooms. Air-con and non air-con rooms. The breakfast is not included in the price if not asked. Beware of the owner's "free" tuk-tuk sc
- **McLeod Inn (Mid-range)**
  - Price: Rs 1,300-1,700 (date of listing unknown)
  - The couple who run the place are all smiles and very helpful. Rooms are sparkling clean, comfy beds, en suite with hot and cold water. Some beautiful views across Kandy from their balcony and from a c
- **Queen's Hotel (Mid-range)**
  - Price: Non-air-con: single US$40-60, double $45-80; Air-con: single $79-94, double $92-122 (date of listing unknown)
  - One of the oldest hotels in Kandy. Offers ideal geataway spots to watch the Maligawa Perahera (the procession).
  - Website: http://www.queenshotel.lk
- **Riverdale Hotel (Mid-range)**
  - Price: From US$42 (date of listing unknown)
- **Heavens Holiday Resort (Mid-range)**
  - Price: Non-air-con: single US$15-20, double $15-20; Air-con: single US$30-40, double $30-40 (date of listing unknown)
  - Heavens Holiday Resort is a nice clean guest house near the Kandy city. They have 3 rooms and 3 bathrooms. One room has a private balcony and others with public balcony. Home made foods are offered th
  - Website: http://www.heavensholidayresort.com
- From Wikivoyage: not booked and availability not checked; contact the hotel. https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Kandy

## Trip budget
- Group: 1 Sri Lankan adult
- Verified entrance fees: LKR 0 (USD 0)
- Other estimated costs: LKR 1,000
- TOTAL estimated budget for the group: LKR 1,000
- Per person: LKR 1,000
- **Requires confirmation**
  - Sri Dalada Maligawa
- **Not included (no reliable source here)**
  - Accommodation (no price listed in the last 3 years for the suggested places)
  - Food and drinks
  - Transport fares (buses, trains, tuk-tuks, a driver)
  - Guides, tips and personal spending
- Other-currency amounts use 1 USD = 332.39 LKR (indicative mid-market rate); a source's own LKR figure is used as given.

## Practical information
- Intercity express trains are hassle-free and scenic, 2½-3 hours, 10 trains per day. _(Wikivoyage)_
- Train tickets from Colombo to Kandy cost Rs 500 in second class and Rs 240 in third class as of 2023. _(Wikivoyage)_
- Local tuk-tuks are a convenient way to get around Kandy, costing around Rs 60-70 per km. _(Wikivoyage)_
- Kandyan dancing performance tickets cost between Rs 2,000 and 3,500 per person as of 2024. _(Wikivoyage)_
- Driving road distance from Colombo to Kandy is 115 km, taking around 2 hours 12 minutes by car without traffic. _(OSRM)_

## Suggestions
_General advice, not checked against live data._
